wiki.title: Sara Feigenholtz
wiki.extract: Sara Feigenholtz (born December 11, 1956) is a Democratic member of the Illinois Senate who has represented the 6th district since 2020. The district includes the lakefront Chicago neighborhoods of Lake View, Lincoln Park, and the Near North Side. From 1995 to 2020, she was a member of the Illinois House of Representatives representing the 12th district.
